summary: A free one-touch arcade game. The core game is playable fully offline. We operate no game servers that store personal data. All personal-data processing is done by named third parties (Google, Apple, a TURN relay provider) for ads, optional leaderboards, optional online 1v1, and Android-only cloud save.

data_collected.name: Advertising ID / IDFA
data_collected.notes: On iOS, tracking use requires opt-in through Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt. Ads still show if tracking is denied; they are simply not personalized.

data_collected.name: Play Games player ID, gamer profile, submitted scores
data_collected.notes: Only if you choose to sign in. Optional; the game is fully playable without it. Only scores are submitted — local progress such as stars and skins is not uploaded.

data_collected.name: Game Center player ID, display name, submitted scores
data_collected.notes: Only if you choose to sign in. Optional. Leaderboards only — iOS progress is not backed up to the cloud.

data_collected.name: Crash data, performance data, other diagnostics
data_collected.processor: Google Play Console (Android) / Apple App Store Connect (iOS)
data_collected.notes: Anonymous. Device model, OS version and stack traces. Cannot be used to identify you.

data_collected.name: Public IP address and ICE candidate data
data_collected.processor: Google STUN, a TURN relay provider, Google Firebase (handshake only)
data_collected.notes: Only when you start or join an online 1v1 match. To coordinate the handshake, Firebase holds the room's connection details, which are deleted once the match connects, and an anonymous account created for that online session. From version 2.1.37 the app deletes that anonymous account when you leave the online session; if it cannot (for example, the app was closed or offline), it retries at a later launch and gives up after 30 days. Until then a small record of that account stays on your device only. No score, purchase or account data is involved.

data_collected.name: Game progress (best scores, owned skins, star balance, settings)
data_collected.notes: Android only, and only if signed in to Google Play Games. Not available on iOS in this version; iOS progress is stored only on the device.

data_not_collected: Apple ID or Game Center credentials

permission_prompts.when: at the player's first run ending or first opt-in ad — never during first launch
permission_prompts.effect_if_denied: The app is fully functional. Ads still show but are not personalized.

third_party_services.name: Google Play In-App Review
third_party_services.role: Android only: may show Google Play's own rating dialog; your rating goes to Google Play, and we never see who rated

third_party_services.name: Google Play In-App Updates
third_party_services.role: Android only: lets Google Play offer an app update

third_party_services.name: Google Firebase
third_party_services.role: WebRTC handshake for online 1v1 only, with an anonymous account for that online session

third_party_services.name: TURN relay provider
third_party_services.role: relays online 1v1 traffic when a direct connection is not possible

opt_out.how: Settings → Google → Ads — reset or delete the Advertising ID
Do not sign in to Game Center or Google Play Games. The game is fully playable without it.
Do not start an online 1v1 match. The rest of the game is unaffected.

retention_and_deletion: We store no personal data ourselves. The connection details of an online match are deleted once it connects. From version 2.1.37 the app deletes the anonymous account it used for an online match when you leave the online session; if it cannot (for example, the app was closed or offline), it retries at a later launch and gives up after 30 days. Until then a small record of that account stays on your device only. Data held by Google or Apple is governed by their policies and can be removed through your Google or Apple account. Deleting the app removes all local game progress on that device.
children: The game is rated 4+ and is not directed at children under the age required by applicable law in your region. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
